rules.statement: A party who appeared in a representative capacity and not personally is entitled to intervene in his personal capacity after interlocutory decree is entered and before the date of the final decree.
rules.supporting_quote: He would accordingly be entitled to intervene up to the date of the final decree, subject to this that the court would be entitled to put him on terms where the intervention was dubious or belated.

meta.parties: De Zoysa v. Gunasekera Et Al
